files.document_title: Michigan Public Service Commission order of May 15, 2025 in Case No. U-21780, Attachment 1 Approved Route Plat, Segment 1 of 4
files.what_it_shows: Satellite background map of segment 1, from the Three Lakes Gate Station at the Northern Natural Gas connection northwest to valve site MLV1 near King Lake, with the approved route as a heavy red line and US Highway 41 marked.
Segment 2, from MLV1 near King Lake northwest to valve site MLV2 at Alberta, route in purple.
Segment 3, from MLV2 at Alberta north-northwest to valve site MLV3 at Six Mile Creek, route in yellow.
landmarks: valve site MLV3 Six Mile Creek

files.what_it_shows: Segment 4, from MLV3 at Six Mile Creek north to Grist Mill Gate Station at the connection with the existing SEMCO pipeline near Baraga, route in light green.

searched: No oilandgaswatch record for this row.
Michigan Public Service Commission news release of May 15, 2025 gave Case No. U-21780.
The e-dockets site is a browser application; instead I located the order PDF on the commission's order document server by scanning document numbers near the order date and found it at number 27138.
Opened the 22-page order and rendered the four Approved Route Plat pages.
notes: The order text also describes the route in words: from near Three Lakes along an existing American Transmission Company electric right-of-way northwest and west for about 8.5 miles to Old U.S. Highway 41, then along Old U.S. Highway 41 for about 1.5 miles, then along another transmission line for about 16.75 miles to Krolik Road, 0.5 mile west on Krolik Road, then north on Grist Mill Road for 2.5 miles to State Highway M-38 and the existing SEMCO pipeline near Baraga. The settlement text in the same order says 16.75 miles along Old U.S. Highway 41, which conflicts with the application summary; the plats should settle it. Route plats are shown on satellite imagery with the route clearly drawn, so the plats could be traced with the roads as control points. The commission approved the route with minor deviations allowed. The sheet length of 30 miles matches.
